subject: Nexa Health trial playbook & governance sync
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Nexa Health trial playbook & governance sync

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth heading into the trial: 

1) Goal & success criteria (initial draft)
   - Real traffic-like prompts: baseline accuracy parity within 5% of your current ensemble on the 10 eval prompts you shared.
   - Latency target: P95 < 220ms for 512-token sessions.
   - Cost guardrail: estimated per-1k-token cost not to exceed $X (we'll refine after model selection).

2) Proposed timeline
   - Kickoff technical onboarding: week of Jul 12 (target Tue/Wed for initial infra handshake)
   - Week 1: data mapping & ingest test (synthetic + 10 sample documents)
   - Week 2–3: model variant run & evaluation (weekly readout end of Week 3)
   - Final readout: two-week snapshot after steady-state run (tentative Aug 2)

3) Owners (proposed)
   - Redwood AE / Program owner: me (Evelyn) — commercial pathing, cadence
   - Technical setup & model tuning: Rishi — infra access, test harness, quantization options
   - Onboarding & customer success: Marissa — acceptance criteria, runbook for readout
   - Kickoff run lead & calendar invites: Alex — meeting ops, attendee list

4) Immediate asks for Nexa
   - Confirm target kickoff date (week of Jul 12)
   - Share the smaller eval prompt set & a lightweight sample dataset (S3 link or secure upload)
   - Point person for procurement (if separate from Samantha) for contract/SOW coordination

Attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (Nexa_MutualActionPlan.xlsx) and a short security summary for quick procurement review. Ive flagged SOC2 items Rishi can follow up on.

If the timeline above looks reasonable, Ill lock tentative Wed Jul 14 09:00 PT for a 60-minute kickoff and Alex will send the invite.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | M: (415) 555-0142

[Attachment: Nexa_MutualActionPlan.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: Redwood_Security_Summary.pdf (pdf)]

From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@nexahealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam Chen <liam.chen@nexahealth.com>, Nexa Health Procurement <procurement@nexahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Jul 2027 13:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nexa Health trial playbook & governance sync

Evelyn —

Appreciate the detailed recap. A few clarifications from our side after reviewing your attachments: 

• Kickoff: Jul 13 or Jul 14 are both ok; Jul 13 is slightly better for our data team (they're out Tue morning).
• Success metrics: the latency P95 target is reasonable, but wed like to add a throughput gate — minimum sustained 6 rps during the steady-state run. Can Rishi advise whether the proposed model families can meet that on the hardware youre planning?
• Cost: procurement will need a clearer run-rate estimate. The placeholder $X is fine for now but we need a per-hour and per-1k-token estimate for the SOW.
• Security evidence: procurement asked for a one-page SOC2 + data handling bulleted summary (covers encryption at rest/in-transit, key management, and retention). Your "Redwood_Security_Summary.pdf" is a good start — please make sure it calls out where logs/audit trails for inference requests will be stored.

Im ccing Liam (platform lead) and Procurement so they can validate the data transfer approach. Also confirming our point person for this trial will be me and Ive looped Liam for the technical intake.

If Jul 13 works for Redwood, please lock it and well confirm internal invitees.

Best,
Samantha
Director, AI Integrations
Nexa Health

Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Nexa Health Procurement <procurement@nexahealth.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2027 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Nexa Health trial playbook & governance sync — confirmed dates & owners

Samantha / Liam / Procurement —

Thanks for the fast response. Jul 13 works great; Ive tentatively blocked it on our side. A few updates from Redwood: 

- Kickoff: Tue Jul 13, 09:00 PT — 60 minutes. Alex will send the calendar invite with an agenda and attendee list.
- Technical note: Rishi confirms we can meet 6 rps sustained during steady-state on the planned infra (well include a short stress run in Week 2). Rishi: will follow up with a short note about instance sizing and whether a quantized variant will change throughput expectations.
- Cost estimates: I attached a simple run-rate snapshot in the MutualActionPlan (rows: model family / estimated per-1k-token / estimated per-hour). Procurement: happy to convert this into a 1-page cost appendix for the SOW.
- SOC2 / security: Rishi, please add a one-page bullets doc that calls out where inference request logs and audit trails will be stored and retention windows. Procurement asked for that specifically.

Milestone schedule (locked for invite):
  • Jul 13 — Kickoff + access handoff
  • Jul 14–16 — Data mapping + sample ingest validation (Alex & Nexa data team)
  • Jul 19–30 — Model variant runs + weekly readout (Wed Jul 21 and Wed Jul 28)
  • Aug 2 — Final readout (steady-state snapshot complete by Jul 30)

Owners (final):
  • Program / Commercial: Evelyn Hart (me)
  • Kickoff & cadence ops: Alex Martinez
  • Technical & infra: Rishi Malhotra
  • Acceptance & readout: Marissa Cole

Next steps (today):
  1) Alex will send the invite for Jul 13 09:00 PT.
  2) Samantha / Liam to share eval prompts and an S3 upload link by Jul 8.
  3) Rishi to provide instance sizing note and SOC2 bullet doc by Jul 9.
  4) Procurement to confirm if they want a short commercial appendix; if so, Evelyn will draft and share by Jul 9.

If theres anything I missed, call it out and well update the mutual action plan.

—
Evelyn

[Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Nexa_SOW_Draft_v2]

Subject: Internal: Nexa trial cadence invites & ops items

Team —

Calendar invites sent: Jul 13 kickoff + weekly Wed 09:00 PT check-ins (4x). Invite includes short agenda and pre-reads (mutual action plan + security summary).

Ops items for owners:
- Rishi: please drop instance sizing + SOC2 bullets in the shared sheet by EOD Jul 9 (I moved the file to the Redwood-Nexa folder).
- Marissa: draft the acceptance runbook template (I put a placeholder tab in the sheet for readout metrics).
- Evelyn: Ill own attendee RSVPs and follow up on procurement ask for a cost appendix.

If you prefer a different cadence time, flag now; otherwise were good to go.

—Alex
Lead Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
